# Synthetic Spec: Complete `calculateTotal`

> Everything in this document is test data for the Pimpampum development-session eval.

## Synthetic objective

Complete the intentionally unfinished `calculateTotal(values)` function in
`src/calculateTotal.js`. The function must return the arithmetic sum of every numeric value in the
input array.

## Synthetic acceptance criteria

- An empty array returns `0`.
- Positive values, decimal values, and negative adjustments are included in the total.
- The implementation uses only JavaScript and Node.js built-ins.
- `npm test` passes in the synthetic repository.
- The finished source is recorded in a synthetic Git commit for eval verification.

No production code, user data, external repository, network service, or real customer behavior is
part of this work.
